in_marathi.name: Gulabika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sweet as Jaggery
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gulabika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gulabika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'gul' meaning jaggery and 'abhaya' meaning fearlessness. This name is often given to a girl who is believed to be as sweet as jaggery and fearless.
